THE SCENE

Your class records a math podcast at the city library. Today you will explain Einstein's proof to the people listening. You will draw his triangle on the board. One line goes from the square corner. It cuts the long side into two parts. You need four lengths for the triangle. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This podcast is about young Albert Einstein in Germany. His uncle told him the Pythagorean theorem. Einstein worked hard and proved it by himself. He used triangles with the same shape.
